title: Marina Bay Penthouse
description: Stunning 4-bedroom penthouse with panoramic views of Marina Bay Sands and the Singapore skyline. Floor-to-ceiling windows, imported Italian marble, and a private rooftop terrace with infinity pool.

title: Palm Jumeirah Villa
description: Opulent 6-bedroom beachfront villa on the iconic Palm Jumeirah. Private beach access, temperature-controlled pool, cinema room, and staff quarters with separate entrance.

title: Downtown Dubai Office Tower
description: Premium Grade-A office space in the heart of Downtown Dubai, offering 360-degree views of Burj Khalifa and the Dubai Fountain. Fully fitted with modern workstations and meeting rooms.

title: Mayfair Georgian Townhouse
description: Exquisite Grade II listed Georgian townhouse in the prestigious Mayfair district. Meticulously restored with original period features blended with contemporary luxury finishes.

title: Manhattan Skyline Apartment
description: Luxury 3-bedroom apartment in a new-build tower in Hudson Yards. Breathtaking views of the Manhattan skyline, access to world-class amenities including a residents-only sky lounge.

title: Bandra Sea-View Apartment
description: Modern 3-bedroom apartment in the upscale Bandra West neighborhood with uninterrupted Arabian Sea views. Part of an integrated township with retail, dining, and recreational facilities.

title: Minato-ku Luxury Residence
description: Ultra-modern 2-bedroom residence in the prestigious Minato ward. Japanese minimalist design with high-end finishes, earthquake-resistant construction, and proximity to Roppongi cultural district.

title: Bondi Beach Coastal Villa
description: Architecturally striking 4-bedroom villa just steps from Bondi Beach. Open-plan living with seamless indoor-outdoor flow, a native rooftop garden, and sustainable solar-powered design.

title: Le Marais Boutique Retail
description: Prime retail space in the historic Le Marais district of Paris. Corner unit with double-height windows, ideal for luxury fashion, art gallery, or concept store. Heavy foot traffic location.

title: South Beach Waterfront Condo
description: Sleek 2-bedroom waterfront condo in Miami South Beach with direct ocean access. Resort-style amenities including a beach club, marina, spa, and multiple dining venues.

title: Alfama Heritage Development Land
description: Rare development opportunity in Lisbon's historic Alfama district. Approved planning permission for a boutique 12-unit residential project with Tagus River views. Includes existing ruins with heritage preservation requirements.

title: Yorkville Mixed-Use Complex
description: Premium mixed-use property in Toronto's affluent Yorkville neighborhood. Ground floor retail with three floors of high-end residential above. Fully leased with strong tenant profiles and long-term leases in place.
